description: Manually authored retrieval judgments from the published catalog, not generated by embedding or inference output. Expected IDs are published entities, including curated groups rather than hidden atomic members. Empty expectations mean no catalog entity answers the requested change on the selected path; related vocabulary alone is insufficient.

cases.query: After upgrading, an average over no matching records no longer passes my null check. What changed?
cases.rationale: The group documents min(), max() and average() returning Undefined rather than Null for empty entity selections from 18 R6; downstream empty-result tests need adapting.

cases.query: How can shipping an updated project avoid wiping out accounts and groups edited at the customer site?
cases.rationale: The project deployment note says a default directory.json can overwrite customer users and groups. Preserve the active file; replacement takes effect after restart, with standalone and Server lifecycle distinctions.

cases.query: Old code that greys out and reactivates a button now fails only when executed, although compilation succeeds.
cases.rationale: DISABLE BUTTON and ENABLE BUTTON were removed in 18 R2; the published group prescribes OBJECT SET ENABLED and warns that runtime error 33 can escape compilation.

cases.query: Our ancient QuickTime compression and image-loading workflow crashes after migration. Which picture operations should replace it?
cases.rationale: The curated group removes the listed QuickTime-era picture calls in 17 R5 and distinguishes codec discovery, conversion, loading and output replacements; it does not remove all picture support.

cases.query: At what migration step does the embedded PHP execution engine itself disappear, rather than just a few bundled extensions?
cases.rationale: The entity explicitly distinguishes removal of the whole internal interpreter in 20 R3 (bucket v21) from v20 module removals and later PHP command deprecation.

cases.query: A Windows build machine can no longer package the Mac client update from the old application folder. What input does it need?
cases.rationale: From v19, Windows builds updating macOS clients require a .4darchive generated on macOS; ClientMacFolderToWin pointing at the old Volume Desktop folder causes a build error.

cases.query: Which migration change removes the PHP settings page?
cases.rationale: The only catalog entity for removing this interface is chg-php-settings-page-removed, introduced in 21 R3, in latest rather than the v21 target bucket.
cases.reason: Out of path: v21 does not include 21 R3. PHP interpreter removal and PHP command deprecation are different changes, not substitute answers.

cases.query: How do I configure directory.json to cache SQL query results between application restarts?
cases.rationale: The project directory.json entities concern user/group storage, export and deployment preservation. The SQL command rename entity concerns naming, not persistent result caching.
cases.reason: Near miss: familiar project and SQL vocabulary, but the catalog documents no directory.json query-cache setting.

cases.query: Mes appels _o_INACTIVER BOUTON et _o_ACTIVER BOUTON passent la compilation mais échouent à l'exécution. Comment conserver le même comportement ?
cases.rationale: The French localization explicitly publishes these two official aliases. Their group records removal in 18 R2, runtime error 33 and replacement with OBJECT SET ENABLED while preserving the enabled state.

cases.query: Par quoi remplacer _o_QT CHARGER ET COMPRESSER IMAGE pour continuer à importer des images sans les anciennes fonctions QuickTime ?
cases.rationale: The French identifier is an authored alias of a removed member of the published picture group. The group distinguishes READ PICTURE FILE loading from conversion and output operations.

cases.query: À chaque livraison du projet, les comptes créés chez le client risquent d'être remplacés par ceux du développeur. Quel fichier faut-il préserver ?
cases.rationale: The project deployment entity identifies directory.json as the user/group store and warns that shipping a default copy overwrites customer changes; preserving the active file is the relevant action.

cases.query: _o_XSLT APPLIQUER TRANSFORMATION ne fonctionne plus : comment migrer la transformation XML sans confondre génération HTML et remplacement XSLT ?
cases.rationale: The French alias belongs to the published XSLT group, removed in 17 R5. The group explicitly says PROCESS 4D TAGS can generate text/HTML but is not a general XSLT substitute.

cases.query: Notre impression utilise _o_PDFCreator Nom imprimante sous Windows. Faut-il prévoir un autre pilote ou considérer que la commande a déjà disparu ?
cases.rationale: The French localization publishes _o_PDFCreator Nom imprimante. The entity says the driver is deprecated from v20, not removed, and recommends assessing the native Windows PDF driver.

cases.query: Le vieux transport réseau disparaît-il aussi pour une base binaire, et doit-on convertir le fichier en projet avant le basculement ?
cases.rationale: In 21 R3, Legacy networking is removed for projects and binary databases alike; the catalog says applications switch automatically to ServerNet without requiring project conversion.

cases.query: Quel changement supprime la page de réglages PHP ?
cases.rationale: chg-php-settings-page-removed begins at 21 R3 in latest. Removing the interpreter or deprecating commands does not establish removal of the settings page in v21.
cases.reason: Out of path: the requested interface removal is later than the selected v21 target.

cases.query: Quel réglage PDFCreator permet de chiffrer les PDF avec un mot de passe différent pour chaque utilisateur ?
cases.rationale: The PDFCreator entity documents driver deprecation, a renamed constant and native-driver replacement, not PDF encryption or per-user password configuration.
cases.reason: Near miss: PDFCreator is a real catalog identifier, but the requested encryption setting is not documented by any catalog entity.

cases.query: Wenn eine Abfrage keine Datensätze findet, liefert der berechnete Mittelwert nicht mehr den erwarteten Nullwert. Welche Anpassung ist nötig?
cases.rationale: The group documents the 18 R6 change from Null to Undefined for min(), max() and average() on empty entity selections and requires adapting result checks and calculations together.

cases.query: Beim Ausrollen einer neuen Projektversion sollen die beim Kunden angelegten Benutzer und Gruppen erhalten bleiben. Was darf das Update nicht überschreiben?
cases.rationale: The deployment note warns that a default directory.json overwrites customer users and groups; it describes preserving the active file and requiring restart after replacement.

cases.query: Seit dem Versionswechsel scheitert das Kompilieren, weil die Punktnotation für Objekte oder die Unicode-Speicherung der Methoden ausgeschaltet ist.
cases.rationale: From v19, compilation fails when object notation or Unicode method storage is off; the group requires compliant code and both Compatibility settings, distinct from the v20 opening requirement.

cases.query: Unsere eigene Benutzerverwaltung exportiert nach der Projektumstellung nur noch einen leeren Binärblock und kann damit keine Konten wiederherstellen.
cases.rationale: The project-mode note states that USERS TO BLOB returns an empty BLOB, so BLOB TO USERS cannot update users from it; user information resides in directory.json. The first release is unknown.

cases.query: Die alte Routine zum Hinzufügen eines Datensegments erzeugt erst zur Laufzeit Fehler 33. Gibt es dafür einen belegten direkten Ersatz?
cases.rationale: _o_ADD DATA SEGMENT was removed in 17 R5 and can fail with runtime error 33 without compiler detection. Its catalog row specifies no replacement and advises redesigning the dependency.

cases.query: Die Einstellungsseite für PHP ist verschwunden. Bedeutet das automatisch, dass auch sämtliche PHP-Befehle entfernt wurden?
cases.rationale: The 21 R3 entity explicitly limits removal to the PHP settings interface and distinguishes it from the separate milestone for command deprecation.

cases.query: Welche Änderung lässt 4D.HTTPRequest.new() ungültige TLS-Zertifikate automatisch zurückweisen?
cases.rationale: chg-http-certificate-validation introduces automatic certificate validation at v20, beyond this path ending at v19.
cases.reason: Out of path: the specific 4D.HTTPRequest.new() validation change is not yet applicable at the selected target.

cases.query: Wie lege ich in directory.json fest, dass Benutzer ihr Passwort alle dreißig Tage ändern müssen?
cases.rationale: The catalog's directory.json entries cover project user/group storage, export behavior and preserving deployed edits, not password expiry policy.
cases.reason: Near miss: a genuine user-management file is named, but no entity documents the requested thirty-day password setting.

cases.query: Cuando no hay registros coincidentes, el cálculo de la media ya no devuelve el nulo que comprobaba mi código. ¿Qué debo revisar?
cases.rationale: The group changes min(), max() and average() on empty entity selections from Null to Undefined in 18 R6; it calls for coordinated changes to empty-result checks and downstream calculations.

cases.query: ¿Cómo entrego una actualización del proyecto sin sustituir las cuentas y los grupos que el cliente creó en producción?
cases.rationale: Project users/groups reside in directory.json; deploying a default copy can overwrite customer changes. The entity describes preserving the active file and restart requirements.

cases.query: Las rutinas antiguas que guardaban cadenas e imágenes en recursos fallan con error 33. ¿Debo trasladar esos datos a archivos normales?
cases.rationale: The published resource-command group records removal in 17 R5 and routes STR# strings to XLIFF, text to text/XLIFF and pictures to modern files, without inventing one-for-one replacements for every private format.

cases.query: El cliente de un proyecto y el servidor están en el mismo equipo, pero ya no aparecen los complementos que antes se copiaban desde el servidor.
cases.rationale: For this same-machine project client/server configuration, the catalog says the client uses its own components and plug-ins instead of downloading the server's; no first release is asserted.

cases.query: Un consumidor externo espera retornos de carro y falla con los archivos de texto de un proyecto nuevo en Mac. ¿Es obligatorio convertir también los proyectos antiguos?
cases.rationale: From 19 R2, new projects default to LF instead of CR for macOS text output, while converted projects opt in via Compatibility; the catalog rejects universal conversion.

cases.query: Las peticiones HTTP nuevas rechazan ahora un servidor con certificado TLS inválido. ¿Cambió la comprobación de confianza por defecto?
cases.rationale: At v20, 4D.HTTPRequest.new() automatically validates TLS certificates and errors on invalid certificates; disabling validation is possible but is not the recommended default.

cases.query: ¿Qué cambio elimina la página de configuración de PHP?
cases.rationale: The interface removal is chg-php-settings-page-removed at 21 R3 in latest, not the earlier internal interpreter removal or command deprecation.
cases.reason: Out of path: the selected target v21 precedes the catalog's PHP settings page removal.

cases.query: ¿Qué ajuste de migración de QuickTime añade automáticamente una marca de agua a todas las imágenes cargadas?
cases.rationale: The QuickTime-era picture group documents removed loading/compression APIs and replacement data flows; it documents no automatic watermark feature or migration setting.
cases.reason: Near miss: picture loading and QuickTime are catalog topics, but watermark automation is not an authored catalog change.

cases.query: 検索結果が0件のとき、平均値をNullと比較していた分岐に入らなくなりました。集計結果の扱いは変わりましたか？
cases.rationale: The group records that min(), max() and average() on an empty entity selection return Undefined rather than Null from 18 R6, requiring updates to result tests and subsequent calculations.

cases.query: プロジェクトの更新配布でdirectory.jsonを上書きすると、お客様が追加したユーザーやグループが消えますか？既存設定を残したいです。
cases.rationale: The project deployment note explicitly warns that a default directory.json overwrites customer user/group changes and describes preserving the active file; replacement needs restart.

cases.query: DISABLE BUTTONでボタンを操作不能にする古い処理が、コンパイルできるのに実行時エラーになります。有効状態の切り替えは何に移しますか？
cases.rationale: DISABLE BUTTON and ENABLE BUTTON are removed in 18 R2; the group prescribes OBJECT SET ENABLED for both states and notes runtime error 33 may escape syntax/compilation checks.

cases.query: Dates inside objectsを有効にしたら、既存のISO文字列も全部日付型へ書き換わるのでしょうか。新旧データの混在が心配です。
cases.rationale: The 16 R6 compatibility option stores new object-attribute dates as date values but leaves existing ISO strings unchanged; the entity calls for testing mixed values and per-process settings rather than mandatory opt-in.

cases.query: Windows上のビルドでClientMacFolderToWinに従来のMacアプリのフォルダーを指定すると失敗します。更新用にMac側で何を作ればよいですか？
cases.rationale: From v19, a Windows build for macOS client updates must use a .4darchive generated on macOS instead of the old Volume Desktop folder; the old key value causes a build error.

cases.query: Legacyの通信方式がなくなると、バイナリ形式のデータベースもプロジェクトへ変換しないとServerNetを使えなくなりますか？
cases.rationale: The 21 R3 entity states that Legacy networking is removed for both binary and project formats and that applications automatically switch to ServerNet without project conversion.

cases.query: PHPの設定ページそのものが削除される変更を知りたいです。
cases.rationale: The catalog dates removal of the PHP settings page to 21 R3, assigned to latest; the v21 command deprecation and earlier interpreter removal are separate changes.
cases.reason: Out of path: a target of v21 does not include the 21 R3 settings-interface removal.

cases.query: ClientMacFolderToWinで配布する.4darchiveに、顧客ごとの暗号化パスワードを設定する方法は？
cases.rationale: The macOS client archive entity documents where to generate the archive and which build input replaces the old folder. It does not document customer-specific archive encryption or password settings.
cases.reason: Near miss: both identifiers are real deployment identifiers, but the requested encryption configuration is absent from the catalog.
